Details  
 The Lucky B Bucking Cropped Tee by Kimes Ranch blends authentic western heritage with modern cowgirl styling. Featuring Kimes Ranch in a classic western font paired with a bucking horse outline, this women’s western cropped tee delivers understated grit with timeless character.
 Created in collaboration with Lucky B Designs, each piece reflects the craftsmanship and artistic dedication behind David’s work. This is more than a graphic tee, it’s a tribute to western heritage, skilled artistry, and the enduring spirit of the American West.
 Crafted from 100% ring-spun cotton and pigment washed for a soft, broken-in feel, the Lucky B Bucking tee offers lived-in comfort from the first wear. The cropped fit pairs effortlessly with high-rise denim, especially styles from the Kimes Ranch women’s jeans collection, creating a balanced, modern western silhouette.
 Easy to style, rooted in tradition, and built for everyday wear, this collaboration tee carries meaning beyond the graphic.
 Fabric: 100% Ring Spun Cotton
 Fit: Women's Cropped, Boxy Fit
 Details: Soft hand print, pigment washed
